candidate.educational_objective: Explain the postpartum therapeutic purpose of oxytocin.

options.A: To suppress uterine contractions and promote uterine relaxation.
options.B: To stimulate uterine contractions and help control postpartum bleeding.
options.C: To provide analgesia for perineal pain.

candidate.rationale: Oxytocin directly stimulates uterine smooth muscle. In the postpartum period it is indicated to produce uterine contractions and control postpartum bleeding or hemorrhage associated with uterine atony.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Oxytocin stimulates uterine smooth muscle and is indicated postpartum to produce uterine contractions and control postpartum bleeding/hemorrhage.
candidate.source_locator: Clinical Pharmacology; Indications and Usage—Postpartum; Dosage and Administration—Control of Postpartum Uterine Bleeding
candidate.stem: After delivery of the placenta, a postpartum client has uterine atony with increased bleeding. Why is oxytocin administered?
